referents.why: 'my shepherd' is first person singular in the psalm's own voice; the psalm does not quote anyone here, so the voice candidate is the referent
'I shall not want' is first person singular in the psalm's own voice

groups.why: the heading 'a Psalm of David' names David as writer, so he is the sender; the heading is the frame and the two clauses are its parts

cant_tell.what: Whether 'I shall not want' (cl2) is a reason for or a result of 'The LORD is my shepherd' (cl1), or simply set beside it
cant_tell.why: The clauses are juxtaposed with a semicolon and no conjunction, no ki or other connective; so no because or result link is recorded.

cant_tell.what: whether 'I shall not want' (cl2) is a consequence of 'The LORD is my shepherd' (cl1)
cant_tell.why: The lines are set side by side with a semicolon and no conjunction; the sense suggests a reason but the form does not state one.
